title: Throne of Eldraine Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
entities.description: A queen who vows to defend the realm until her last breath.

entities.name: Gadwick, the Wizened
entities.description: A figure whose name is spoken only in whispers, yet who hears it just the same.

entities.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
entities.description: A noblewoman of Locthwain whose mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

entities.name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
entities.description: A dwarf thane. His flavor text says a dwarf's grudge runs deeper than the mountains' roots.

entities.name: Ceri
entities.description: The royal mirrorkeeper, who says the Mirror reveals a person's soul's essence.

entities.name: The Mirror
entities.description: A mirror that reveals a person's soul's essence once they share their darkest secret.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: A court of the realm whose aspirants must step through the flame. Its loyalty keeps the realm from devouring itself.

entities.name: Embereth
entities.description: A court of the realm whose courage keeps the realm from faltering.

entities.name: Garenbrig
entities.description: A court of the realm whose strength keeps the wilds at bay. Ennor was cast out of it.

entities.name: Locthwain
entities.description: A court of the realm whose persistence keeps the realm from stagnating.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: A court of the realm whose knowledge keeps the realm out of darkness.

entities.name: Blacklances
entities.description: Knights who travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years, searching for the lost Cauldron of Eternity.

entities.name: Cauldron of Eternity
entities.description: A lost cauldron that the Blacklances seek.

entities.name: Ellwen
entities.description: A person kept in a guarded chamber who vanished overnight.

entities.name: Ennor
entities.description: A man cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes who used fae magic to make a weapon for his revenge.

entities.name: Legend of the Gilded Knights
entities.description: An in-world written tale about the Gilded Knights.

events.summary: Ellwen, locked in her chamber by the guards, vanishes overnight.
events.quote: By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

events.summary: Ennor is cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes and turns to fae magic to fashion a weapon for his revenge.
events.quote: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

events.summary: The Blacklances travel into the wilds for years in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.
events.quote: The Blacklances travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years at a time, in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.
